name: oh-my-tui
description: Personal Terminal: single-owner remote terminal manager (Server + npm Agent)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @oh-my-tui/protocol && npm run build -w @oh-my-tui/web && npm run build -w @oh-my-tui/server && npm run build -w @oh-my-tui/agent
scripts.test: npm run test -w @oh-my-tui/server && npm run test -w @oh-my-tui/agent
